label: eBay Advertising (Promoted Listings)
terms_note: Marketing API use requires an eBay developer account and the seller's OAuth authorisation (documentation not opened this session).

discovery.auth: oauth2 (eBay developer app; user token with scope https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.marketing)

auth: 1. eBay developer program app (client id / secret); seller authorizes with the authorization-code grant including scope `https://api.ebay.com/oauth/api_scope/sell.marketing`.
2. User access token (2 h) + refresh token (18 months) on `Authorization: Bearer`; `X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID` where required.
3. Seller must be eligible for Promoted Listings (good standing).

endpoints.purpose: campaigns + funding strategy (COST_PER_SALE bidPercentage / COST_PER_CLICK budget)
endpoints.notes: campaignName, fundingStrategy{fundingModel, bidPercentage, adRateStrategy}, budget{daily}, startDate, endDate, marketplaceId, channels
reportType, dateFrom, dateTo, dimensions, metricKeys, campaignIds

reference.limits: - Per-app daily call limits (developer portal); free; eBay API License Agreement; Promoted Listings fees are ad rate / CPC charged by eBay.
mcp_sdk: Official eBay SDKs (Java / .NET / Python via OpenAPI) and Postman collections on developer.ebay.com (blocked this pass).

reason: eBay's Marketing API reference is still unreadable: on 2026-09-25 headless Chromium on a datacenter host got eBay's 'SORRY Something went wrong on our end' error page for https://developer.ebay.com/api-docs/sell/marketing/overview.html, …/resources/methods, …/resources/campaign/methods/getCampaigns, …/static/overview.html and https://developer.ebay.com/develop/api/sell/marketing_api (as did plain HTTP with a browser agent: 403). The official eBay GitHub org has no Marketing API spec (its npm-public-api-mcp server fetches specs from https://api.ebay.com/developer/mcp/v1/search, which answers 'Missing access token'), so no Promoted Listings endpoint could be verified from an official page; the adapter is deferred until the reference can be read.
